messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate at api-gateway-edge (eu-west1) — 502/504 spike detected. P95 latency ↑, errors at 18% of requests in the last 2m. Paging: @carol @david @sam oncall. :rotating_light:
carol: saw this — hitting dashboards now. is this global or regional?
david: looks regional to eu-west1 edge pool, other regions fine. errors all show upstream 502/504 from app-backend group b-eu-03.
sam: replays show nginx logs `upstream prematurely closed connection` + `upstream timed out (110)` from the same subset. copying logs.
carol: any recent deploys?
emma: there was a small config push 9m ago to envoy routing (route header timeout bump) rolled by infra team. not sure if related.
david: grabbing histograms — increased connection resets around the time of the config roll.
infra-bot: deploy:infra-config @emma completed at 2309003800 — change set: envoy/edge timeout tweaks.
sam: quick check: curl to edge -> gets 502 with body `upstream read error`. sample: ```curl -v https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/health -H "Host: api.redwood.example.com"``` returns 502 on eu-west1 only.
carol: ok mitigation plan: 1) remove b-eu-03 host group from LB 2) rollback envoy config to previous 1.2.3 3) shift 10% traffic to eu-central fallback while we validate 4) notify support & customers in affected region
oncall-sre: I'm primary oncall — will lead. @david you're secondary. @sam you run rollback with me.
david: ack. starting removal of b-eu-03 from pool (admin API).
sam: issuing: ```POST https://admin.internal/remove-host {"host":"b-eu-03"}``` — response 200. host drained.
carol: good, start moving 10% traffic to eu-central via routing policy: ```PATCH /routing/policy {"match":{"region":"eu-west1"},"fallback":"eu-central","weight":10}```
emma: rolling back infra-config now to 1.2.3 — watch for config publish events.
infra-bot: rollback initiated for deploy:infra-config by emma at 2309003895.
carol: infra-bot, can you confirm envoy configs pushed and that hot reload succeeded?
infra-bot: hot reload success on 6/6 edges in eu-west1 at 2309003940.
david: metrics: 502 rate dropping from 18% -> 7% within 30s of host removal. p95 latency improving.
sam: after rollback, I'm seeing far fewer `upstream prematurely closed` in logs.
oncall-sre: great. keep the fallback in place for 30 minutes, then ramp down if stable.
support-bot: alerting support rotation: high severity incident in eu-west1, 502/504 spike, mitigation in progress (hosts drained, config rollback). templates queued for customers in EU.
carol: any sign of backend overload or memory OOMs?
david: b-eu-03 had elevated connection queue and some 502 responses correlated with max-connections hitting threshold. not seeing OOM. likely a regression in header handling that caused upstream to drop connections under load.
emma: looking at envoy diff: the header timeout change inadvertently toggled keepalive behavior in the worker. rolling back reverted that.
sam: we should also add a short-lived client retry (idempotent) layer for edge for 5xx windows. propose 2 retries with jitter on 502/504 for next 24h.
oncall-sre: agree, but limit to idempotent endpoints. put a feature flag and monitor.
carol: postmortem TODOs: - root cause analysis of config interaction with backend keepalive - improve canary window for edge config (increase probe coverage) - add circuit-breaker thresholds for backend group - add automated host-level drain when connection queue > 90%
david: creating incident ticket INC-2309004321 and adding logs/traces. assigning RCA lead @emma.
emma: will run deeper heap/stack and tcp dump on b-eu-03 historical traces and report in ticket.
support-bot: customer impact: ~12% of EU traffic affected max, some API calls retried by clients, a few error reports opened. escalation team notified.
oncall-sre: status update in 15m or earlier if anything changes. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
carol: keeping fallback for 30m. removing host seems to have stabilized. will start postmortem draft after stabilization.
sam: adding quick dashboard alert rule to detect identical stack trace fingerprints and alert faster.
david: last check — 502 rate steady ~1.2% now, p95 within SLO. lowering pager.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: error rate returned to baseline in eu-west1 at 2309004518. Summary posted to INC-2309004321.
carol: closing thread when postmortem link added.
